description.value: The Saanich Keg is a full-service steakhouse and bar occupying a historic former winery building on Quadra Street, operating at this location since 1979. It is part of the well-known Canadian Keg Steakhouse + Bar chain and offers dine-in, bar/lounge seating, patio, and takeout. Situated about half a mile south of McKenzie Avenue, it sits along a busy arterial route commonly used by cyclists travelling between communities in Greater Victoria.
